title: Clean FIO composition and transport with derivative loss
source_hypothesis: Fixed 1/2<rho<=1 and delta=1-rho. Real homogeneous canonical relations with full cotangent closure and no zero-component axes; proper actual kernel supports and proper clean matching to a fixed embedded image. Scalar transport allows nonproper A, but P is proper on half-densities, with chosen homogeneous principal p vanishing on the projected relation and ordinary remainders through order s-2.
component_scope: General-rho kernel maps, antidual adjoints, clean composition, actual product limits, all symbol remainders, ordered fiber densities and the scalar transport theorem with exact m+s-rho order, m+s-2rho full-graph error and intrinsic epsilon quotient.

source_result_coverage.source_result_and_scope: Definition 25.2.1 and kernel action, all strong topology and missing-axis contracts
Theorem 25.2.2 general-rho adjoint and exact antidual symbol
Theorem 25.2.3 general-rho clean proper composition with all derivatives, full remainders and exact density normalization
Theorem 25.2.4, formula 25.2.11 and Lemma 25.2.5: full scalar general-rho transport with actual order and principal/full-graph precision
Three exact sharpness, proper localization and compact-fiber matrix solutions
